Australia v England. Coverage of the first Twenty20 in the five-match series, which takes place at Melbourne Cricket Ground. The hosts haven't won a T20 series against England since early 2014 when they claimed a 3-0 whitewash at home thanks to victories by 13 runs, eight wickets and 84 runs. The most recent series between these two teams ended in a 1-1 draw back in September 2024 after the third and final game was abandoned without a ball being bowled because of rain in Manchester.

Manchester City v Fulham (Kick-off 12.30pm). Coverage of the top-flight match from Etihad Stadium. The hosts have dominated this fixture over the last 15 years or so and have an incredible record against the London club since 2009. Since a 3-1 victory for Fulham at this ground in April 2009 the hosts haven't lost against them in 26 meetings. The visitors have only picked up three points in that run and have lost 20 consecutive games against the North-West club.
